title: Second moment of a sign-valued function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. The expectation of $f^2$ under $\pi$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
